name: Applied Graphics
subTagline: Vehicle wraps, building interiors & exteriors, and large-format signage — engineered in Kenilworth, NJ since 1978.
shortDescription: Applied Graphics Inc. is a 3M-certified graphics company in Kenilworth, New Jersey, branding vehicles and buildings inside and out — vehicle and fleet wraps, wall murals, storefront and window graphics, architectural finishes and large-format signage. From a single color-change to a 500-vehicle fleet or a full building, we design, print and install it all under one roof.
